title: Living Things — Needs, Habitats & Environmental Changes
description: Explore what plants and animals need, connect a frog to habitat evidence, notice how living things change places, and observe a seed growing over time.
learningFocus: Use pictures and observations to describe what plants and animals need to live.
Identify evidence that living things can change their surroundings and record plant growth over time.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to point to picture evidence before explaining each answer, and record their exact words when the page invites an oral response. During the seed observation, keep the growing conditions consistent and record what is actually seen and measured without promising a particular result.

seo.title: Living Things Worksheets | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Four free Kindergarten science activities about plant and animal needs, habitats, environmental changes, and observing plant growth.
